official_measurement_examples.name: Dual-running 2026
official_measurement_examples.fact: Legacy and new local-plan systems operate concurrently during 2026; process lineage must be retained rather than merged.

official_measurement_examples.name: Legacy submission cutoff
official_measurement_examples.fact: The published transition material identifies 31 December 2026 as the final date for submissions under the legacy route.

official_measurement_examples.name: New-system commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The new plan-making system was introduced from March 2026 and uses gateway stages before examination.

official_measurement_examples.name: Examination is not adoption
official_measurement_examples.fact: Submission or examination does not itself mean a local plan has been adopted.

official_measurement_examples.name: Main modifications
official_measurement_examples.fact: Inspector-led main modifications during examination must not be treated as adopted policy until the statutory process completes.

official_measurement_examples.name: Emerging-policy weight
official_measurement_examples.fact: The existence of an emerging policy or examination document does not automatically give it the same status as an adopted development-plan policy.

official_measurement_examples.name: July 2026 viability letter
official_measurement_examples.fact: The July 2026 ministerial letter concerns a pragmatic and proportionate examination approach; it does not guarantee that any specific plan is sound.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: A local-plan stage or examination status does not by itself determine parcel ownership, permission or final yield.

core_rules: legacy and new plan systems remain distinct
gateway pass is not adopted policy
main modification is not adopted policy until process completes
emerging policy is not automatically full-weight adopted policy
soundness examination is plan-level not parcel permission
ministerial examination guidance is not plan approval
plan timetable is not delivery guarantee
local plan does not establish land ownership
absence of allocation is not automatic refusal
legacy/new procedure lineage must be retained
no parcel clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Planning Inspectorate and MHCLG material checked 2026-07-26, including 18-20 July 2026 guidance and the 2026 dual-running transition.
